hook_text: 1 128 sweets in bags of 24. How many bags? Guessing is allowed, if you do it cleverly.
clip_script: A spaza shop in Tembisa: 1 128 sweets, bags of 24. Box times 24 equals 1 128. Guess 40: 960. Too small! Guess 50: 1 200. Too big! It is between. Closer to 1 200, so try 47: 1 128. Bang on! Now prove it: put 47 back in. 47 times 24 is 1 128. Both sides match. That is substitution. Someone says 10 for 3 times box plus 5 equals 32? Put it in: 35. Wrong! Try 9: 32. Guess, test, prove.
visual_style: A guess-o-meter needle swinging between too small and too big, settling on just right, then the answer dropping into the box with a check mark.
mood: Game-show suspense with a satisfying win.
pacing: Quick guesses with sound effects, a pause before the exact hit, then a fast proof.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the mystery number that doubles and adds 15 to make 85.
